senses.gloss: ע׳ של ברזל wrought iron, bar, ball.—Pl. עֲשָׁשִׁיּוֹת.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 34b:4">Yoma 34ᵇ</cite> <he>ע׳ של ברזל וכ׳</he> lumps of wrought iron were heated for the high priest on the eve of the Day of Atonement; <cite ref="Tosefta Yoma 1:20">Tosef. ib. I, 20</cite> (Var. <cite ref="P01515"><he>עששית</he></cite>); Y. ib. III, 40ᶜ <he>עֲשָׁשׁוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 16a:3">Ab. Zar. 16ᵃ</cite> <he>אין מוכרין להם ע׳ וכ׳</he> we must not sell them (the Romans) iron bars, … because they forge arms out of them (expl. <he>פרזלא הינדואה</he>, v. <cite ref="E00451"><he>הִינְדָּוָא</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 108b:2">Snh. 108ᵇ</cite> <he>יש לנו ע׳ וכ׳</he> we have iron plates with which we can pave the ground (to prevent water coming up).
<cite ref="Berakhot 25b:10">Ber. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>בע׳</he> covered with a translucent substance.
<cite ref="Berakhot 53a:2">Ib. 53ᵃ</cite> <he>ע׳ שהיתה דולקת וכ׳</he> a lantern which has been burning the whole day (of the Sabbath); Y. ib. VI, 12ᵇ bot.
R. Hash. 24ᵃ ראינוהו בע׳ we have seen the reflection of the moon in a crystal, v. אֶשֶׁשׁ; a. e.—Pl. as ab.
<cite ref="Shabbat 154b:2">Sabb. 154ᵇ</cite> <he>היתה בהמתו … וע׳</he> if his beast is laden with … glass lumps, expl.
